channel.title: BlazeMeter incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from BlazeMeter's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Capacity Issues with Google Public Locations [resolved]
New User Registrations are currently broken [resolved]
item.description: The incident with new user registration has been resolved

item.title: Issue with JMeter Plugins Repository Certificate [resolved]
item.description: Our tests are continuing to run as expected and we have received confirmation from other sources as well. At this time, we are resolving the incident.

item.title: Some Dedicated IPs Encountering Issues when Running Tests [resolved]
item.description: The fixes that have been applied are working as expected and teams should be able to use their Dedicated IPs again without issue. We are resolving the incident at this time

item.title: Issues with Starting or Stopping Tests due to database maintenance. [resolved]
mock.blazemeter.com was briefly displaying a 404 when navigating to it. [resolved]
item.description: We are resolving the incident now as the issue has been fixed for some time and we have given time for users to see the message. As a reminder, if you Services are in Failed state then you just need to restart them and they should again be functioning as expected.

item.title: The US Illinois Location for API Monitoring is offline [resolved]
item.description: Our tests have continued to run successfully from the US Illinois location. At this time you may resume utilizing the US Illinois location in your tests if you would like. We are closing the incident now.

item.title: DATA Processing delays in Blazemeter [resolved]
item.description: We are no longer seeing the data processing delays with our tests at this time. We are resolving the incident now, but will continue to monitor for any potentially lingering issues.

item.title: Data Processing Delays Causing Long Test Shutdown Times [resolved]
item.description: The fix for the data processing issue has been deployed now and we are seeing improvement in our tests as well. At this time we are resolving the incident.
